Definition: properly, an assembly figuratively, a troop
BiblicalUsage: Moad is an appointed time, a fixed season — howl, O gate, cry, O city, for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times, when the muster is called.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the appointed times belong to God: He calls the muster, and no one stands alone in it.
